answer: Anchor-Led Bookkeeping: each agent must submit periodic, independently checkable work receipts whose history is co-signed by a rotating set of peers; new identities start with zero receipts and must complete a paid harbor verification task before earning trust. Cloning costs the full verification fee plus lost throughput while the clone accumulates receipts, and detection forfeits that sunk cost—so each marginal clone is strictly negative-EV. Juniper.
